pinev: 1902 Fergus Falls city directory: 'Trommler, Frederick W., res s end Mill st', matching the Ugeblad's 'Mill Str. syd' (1903). Pin at the south end of S Mill St where it meets W Alcott Ave (OSM intersection); the 1903 Sanborn shows Mill St ending at Alcott Ave.
No house number, so the circle covers the south end of the street; spelling and first name vary between sources. The Minneapolis Journal spells him Trommler, as does the 1902 directory.

Pension index (Ancestry 4654, image 32959_033144-01132): one William Trombla, Co. K 118th NY Inf., filed 14 May 1885 from Minnesota, wife Amanda on the card. Possible identity only; a wife conflicts with the bachelor story.

Minneapolis Journal, 28 Sep 1903: F. W. Trommler, one-armed Civil War veteran, 'lived alone in a small house in the extreme southern part of the city'; found helpless in bed Saturday 26 Sep 1903 and died at St. Luke's. Independent of the directory, this puts the house at the south edge of town and supports the S Mill St placement.
